meta.title: Mivora – Family activities in Cologne
meta.description: Find classes, workshops, holiday camps and free activities for children in Cologne and plan your family week.

profile.privacyText: We store as little as possible. Your children's data is never public.

welcome.title: Welcome to Mivora
welcome.subtitle: Discover classes, outings and holiday activities for kids in your city.
welcome.cityQuestion: Which city do you live in?
welcome.cityHint: You can change the city any time at the top of the app.
welcome.cityError: Please choose a city from the list.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.intro: Sign in with your email. We'll send you a 6-digit code – no password needed.
auth.codeSent: We sent a code to {email}. It's valid for 10 minutes.
auth.invalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address.
auth.rateLimited: Too many codes requested. Please wait 15 minutes.
auth.invalidCode: The code is wrong or has expired.
auth.noDatabase: Family accounts in this preview only work with the local database.
auth.privacy: We only use your email to sign you in. No newsletter, no sharing.
auth.devMailHint: Development: all emails go to the local inbox at localhost:8025.
auth.mailFailed: We couldn't send the email right now. Please try again in a moment.

family.signInPitch: With an account you can add child profiles and find matching activities faster.
family.childrenPrivacy: Child profiles are private and only visible to you. We only store a nickname, birth year and interests.
family.nicknameHint: No real name needed – e.g. "Bunny" or "Big one".
family.age: about {age, plural, =0 {under 1 year} one {# year} other {# years}}
family.deleteText: Deletes your account, all child profiles and sign-ins immediately and permanently.
family.deleteConfirm: I want to delete my account permanently.
family.deletedDone: Your account and all child profiles have been deleted.
family.confirmMissing: Please tick the box to confirm deletion.

email.subject: Your Mivora code: {code}
email.expiry: The code is valid for 10 minutes. If this wasn't you, you can ignore this email.

sync.synced: Synced with your family account – the same on all your devices.
sync.signIn: Sign in to have it on all your devices

provider.title: List an activity
provider.intro: Do you run classes, workshops or holiday programmes for kids in Cologne? List them here for free. We review every listing before parents see it.
provider.signInFirst: Sign in to list an activity. All you need is your email address.
provider.none: You haven't submitted any listings yet.
provider.submittedDone: Thanks! We've received your listing. We'll review it before it appears – you can follow its status here.
provider.profileCta: Do you run activities for kids? List yours.
provider.bookingHint: Without a link, parents can send you an enquiry later.
provider.confirmRights: I'm allowed to publish this activity and the details are correct.
provider.confirmReview: I understand Mivora reviews listings before publishing and may decline them.
provider.limit: You already have 10 listings in review. Please wait until we've reviewed them.

errors.order: Must be after the first value

admin.title: Review
admin.reasonLabel: Reason for declining (shown to the provider)
admin.approved: Approved – the listing is now visible.
admin.rejected: Declined – the provider can see the reason.
admin.failed: That didn't work. Was it already handled?
